units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 34:27">Targ. Gen. XXXIV, 27</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:11">Esth. R. to I, 10</cite> (play on <he>בזתא</he> ibid.) <he>בוז ביתיה</he> plunder his house.

senses.gloss: to tread. Ib. (play on בגתא ואבגתא ibid. as if from בג, cmp. בגד) בוז ובזבז tread and shatter (v. Targ. Esth. a. l.; cmp. בָּזוֹזָא). [Most of the forms may be derived fr. בזז.]
